title: thelypteris tetragona var. guadalupensis
intro: Thelypteris tetragona var. guadalupensis, commonly known as Guadalupe Rattlesnake Fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential benefits as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent to promote wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Guadalupe Rattlesnake Fern include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant are mainly flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
